findingsReportedNotFixed.finding: The row arms NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_MODE and MEKSTATION_E2E_CAMPAIGN_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY to reach the genesis refusal while the constant is false. U35d deletes the arm; the row then still refuses (the constant is true), but its env arming is dead and its comment (it proves the route hands the checkpoint the resolver's answer rather than the production constant) no longer describes it. U35d's ownership paths do not include src/__tests__/unit/api. Not changed here: without the arm the row cannot refuse while the flag is false.

The shared fixture's makeForce gives every force unitIds ['unit-a', 'unit-b'], so buildPopulatedCampaign always double-claims and the genesis projection refuses it; each genesis-dependent suite re-derives the same disjoint-membership override inline. A grep for the override text ({ ...force, unitIds: [`unit-${index}`] }) under src finds it in 13 test files, 3 of them added by this unit (campaigns.test.ts, campaigns.authority.test.ts, the co-op suite). A genesis-projectable fixture variant would remove the copies; the fixture is outside this unit's paths.
